Method of Attack: Running fake survey campaigns to collect personal information by impersonating popular companies and influencers, using social engineering and shortlink redirections to lure victims into completing surveys
Impersonation of YouTube accounts and popular content creators to increase scam credibility
Use of fake web pages (e.g., fake Apple page) to convince victims to provide personal data
Monetization by getting paid for filling out surveys through tricking users
Attack Vector: Social engineering via fake survey links on YouTube messages and posts
Use of spoofed YouTube accounts with popular avatars
Shortlink redirections leading to survey pages
Fake web pages mimicking legitimate companies
Indicators of Compromise: URLs associated with fake survey campaigns
